name: Chat Assist Evaluation
description: Evaluation dataset for the chat assist agent covering translation, grammar correction, tone adjustment, rephrasing, drafting, and making text concise.

cases.input: Translate this to Vietnamese: 'The sprint goal is to complete the AI evaluation pipeline. All agents must be above 75% by end of sprint.'
cases.expected_output: The assistant provides the Vietnamese translation: 'Mục tiêu của sprint là hoàn thành pipeline đánh giá AI. Tất cả các agent phải đạt trên 75% trước khi kết thúc sprint.'

cases.input: Translate this to English: 'Chúng tôi đã triển khai phiên bản v2.2.0 lên môi trường staging và tất cả các bài kiểm thử khói đều đã qua.'
cases.expected_output: The assistant provides the English translation: 'We have deployed version v2.2.0 to the staging environment and all smoke tests have passed.'

cases.input: Translate this to French: 'Your whole team, one place. Serenity helps teams communicate and ship faster.'
cases.expected_output: The assistant provides the French translation: 'Toute votre équipe, au même endroit. Serenity aide les équipes à communiquer et à livrer plus rapidement.'

cases.input: Fix the grammar in this message: 'We has been working on the evaluation pipeline since last sprint and the result is showing great improvement across all of the agent we tested.'
cases.expected_output: The assistant corrects the grammar: 'We have been working on the evaluation pipeline since last sprint and the results are showing great improvement across all of the agents we tested.'

cases.input: Make this message sound more professional: 'hey just wanted to check if the pr is done yet, been waiting a bit'
cases.expected_output: The assistant rewrites the message professionally, e.g.: 'Hi, I wanted to follow up on the status of the PR. Please let me know when it is ready for review. Thank you.'

cases.input: Make this message warmer and more encouraging: 'QA is complete. Two bugs were found. They will be fixed before release.'
cases.expected_output: The assistant rewrites the message with a warmer tone, e.g.: 'Great news — QA is complete! We found two bugs that we will take care of before the release. Almost there!'

cases.input: Make this more direct and concise: 'I was wondering if it might be possible for us to perhaps consider scheduling a meeting at some point next week to go over the Q3 OKRs together if everyone is available and it works for the team.'
cases.expected_output: The assistant rewrites it concisely, e.g.: 'Can we schedule a meeting next week to review the Q3 OKRs?'

cases.input: Rephrase this update so it sounds more enthusiastic: 'Evaluation results are in. Contacts agent scored 91%. All agents are above the 75% threshold.'
cases.expected_output: The assistant rephrases the message with more enthusiasm, e.g.: 'Exciting news — the evaluation results are in! The contacts agent hit an impressive 91%, and every single agent is now above the 75% threshold. Great work, team!'

cases.input: Draft a polite message to decline a meeting invitation for next Monday's 9 AM Weekly Team Standup because I have a conflict.
cases.expected_output: The assistant drafts a polite decline message, e.g.: 'Hi, thank you for the invitation. Unfortunately I have a conflict and will not be able to attend the Weekly Team Standup on Monday at 9 AM. I will catch up on any updates afterwards. Apologies for the inconvenience.'

cases.input: Draft a brief status update message to send to #general saying that the evaluation notebook is now stable and all 7 agents are green.
cases.expected_output: The assistant drafts a short #general update, e.g.: 'Good news — the evaluation notebook is now stable. All 7 agents have passed the 75% threshold and are green. Thanks everyone for your contributions this sprint!'

cases.input: Draft a friendly reminder to send to Bob Chen about reviewing PR #52.
cases.expected_output: The assistant drafts a friendly reminder, e.g.: 'Hey Bob, just a friendly reminder to take a look at PR #52 when you get a chance. Let me know if you have any questions. Thanks!'

cases.input: I need to reply to this message. Help me write a professional reply.
cases.expected_output: The assistant asks what the original message said and what key points the user wants to include in the reply before drafting it.

conversation_context.content: Sarah sent: 'Can you confirm the AI infrastructure cost for Q3 and prepare a summary for the board?'
Sure, I can help you draft a professional reply to Sarah. What key points would you like to include — for example, the cost figure and any context you want to provide?

The cost is $2,400/month. It covers GPU instances and OpenAI API usage. It will drop 30% once we switch to our own model for G-Eval. I need to reply to this message. Help me write a professional reply.
